summary: A Readymag scroll story for Nouvelle Noire's NN Konrad, a revival of Sweynheym and Pannartz's 1465 Subiaco proto-roman. It runs from the 1462 sack of Mainz, told with surreal black-and-white illustrations, through a 'nerd section' (archival scans, a gothic-to-roman 'n' lineage, a 2015–2023 making-of) to a purple-black-cream specimen grid, a glyph set and buy buttons. Three purple ribbon tabs (Buy, Free tryals, Download specimen) hang from the top of every screen.

instances.variantDefinition: One letter drawn from each historical model leading to the new typeface, lined up on a timeline (e.g. gothic → gotico-antiqua → proto-roman → this font → roman), each captioned with source, date and role: a static typographic family tree.
instances.look: 'The evolution from gothic to roman printing types.' in purple, then five large 'n's on a thin arrow line (Textura, Gotico-Antiqua, Proto-Roman, NN Konrad in purple, Roman), each above a cross mark, a bold label and a short paragraph with the source type and date; a rotating 'TIME LAPSE' text badge below
instances.ux: Static; links credit the ANRT Nancy gotico-antiqua revival
instances.learn: Put your letter in its family tree, one 'n' per stage: the reader sees exactly which step the new design takes
